manuscript.title: Entropy-budget minimax losses under growing thermal noise
manuscript.author: Lluis Eriksson

unresolved_objections.title: Wrong pinpoint attribution for the exact-type mutual-information estimate
unresolved_objections.finding: Berta–Gharibyan–Walter 1603.02282v2 Lemma 9 proves arbitrary-index compound achievability, not I(pi_T,N^tensor k)>=kI(sigma_p,N)-2d_k.
unresolved_objections.resolution: Cite the earlier entropy/optical manuscript Lemma 3 or insert the short relative-entropy/type proof; retain Berta et al. as the coding dependency.
unresolved_objections.effect_on_main_result: The inequality was analytically checked and is valid. No material change to the theorem is required.

optional_suggestions.suggestion: Show the short thermal-tail mutual-information derivation of U_E supplied in report section 6.

scores.overall_convention: Research-importance judgment, not the average of diagnostics or technical quality.
scores.importance_basis: Strong specialized growing-thermal extension with all-input and uniform operational control; prior entropy curve and coding mechanisms retained. No evidence of broad field/historic impact.
scores.technical_basis: Substantive all-input proof, justified infinite-dimensional steps and physical-cost common coding; one nonmaterial citation correction and selective external proof verification.

correctness_confidence.basis: All main proof steps examined; no material failure found; not formal verification.

rigor.basis: Fixed reference, normalized comparison, infinite limit and type cost handled; type attribution needs correction and some estimates are terse.

novelty.basis: Specific growing-noise minimax extension appears new among inspected passages; major ingredients and earlier pure-loss curves are prior; search directed.

significance.basis: Useful specialized asymptotic theorem; no demonstrated broader field effect or efficient coding result.

reproducibility.basis: Frozen package, all hashes and byte-identical replay verified; diagnostics limited to scalar/finite-matrix checks.

supported_claim: Theorem 1 and Proposition 3, with n=o(E) or a known N=o(E) envelope, fixed parameters within each block, all finite entropy budgets and the stated physical expected energy/EA/average-error conventions.
actual_coverage: Complete eight-page exact PDF, rendered and extracted, and complete main.tex.
All 17 frozen manifest payload sizes and SHA256 hashes.
Both supplied diagnostic programs, README/runtime/replay records and all result rows parsed; fresh replay.
True two-mode complementary spectrum, Gaussian benchmark and fixed-channel derivative.
Quadratic-form Gibbs pullback, data-processing sign and Xi for all positive n=o(E).
Prior bounded Choi form, correct normalization/constants and regularization to arbitrary input.
Near-capacity largest-eigenvalue control and low-information/near-capacity split covering every input.
Fixed rho_R reference through pinching, cross-entropy finiteness, normalized comparator and +log v.
TRE source proof/sign repair, normalized order corollary and infinite-reference compression limit.
Input-dependent Helstrom test as an analytic device, uniformity in a and explicit R_minus.
Thermal witness all-input converse without assuming a mixed-channel thermal optimizer.
Input/output truncation errors U_E and W_E, positive reset compression with no reset energy.
Exact type-space physical cost and arbitrary-index common EA coding, correct limit order.
All finite budgets, Shannon clipping, fixed alpha>1 tail, saturation/B=0 and infinite reset Shannon entropy.
Unknown fixed signal family with known envelope; ordering only the signal, endpoints kappa=1/n=0.
Linear-noise counterexample and limitations of any necessity claim.
Versioned primary dependency passages and close antecedents; directed novelty comparison.
limitations: Model referee report, not formal proof, human peer review or editorial acceptance.
Requested model/effort are not independently attested; shared files and retained context; independence unknown and no blindness claim.
Preparatory audit615 support was visible in the manuscript disclosure; its report was not read.
Incidental numerical assessment exposure from an older, different public AIRR search result is declared.
Directed literature search and selected proof reading, not exhaustive priority verification or re-proving every imported coding dependency.
Finite diagnostic replay is not independent implementation, capacity optimization, operational coding or asymptotic certification.
The theorem fixes lambda, kappa and finite alpha; no uniformity at singular parameter boundaries or across unspecified sublinear paths.
No within-block parameter variation, efficient code, uniform finite-blocklength estimate, exact finite-energy mixed-channel capacity or complete critical-noise classification is established.

context.incidental_exposures: Manuscript disclosure of preparatory support, plus an older unrelated public AIRR numerical assessment in a search result; see provenance/search-scope.

preservation: Review598 and audit602 unchanged and not superseded. No regrade or retry for a higher score. C copy retained; D conservation copy verified separately.
